title: Early Migration of Chinese Art to theWest: The Role of Turks and Arabs
content: China was the key source of novel materials and innovations that played a crucial role in the development of medieval Europe. Here, I use an unconventional method based on mathematics of ornamental arts to trace the path of Chinese goods to the West. Using the concept of the wallpaper group, this study analyzes Chinese ornaments to identify similarities with the artwork of the Arabs and Turkish Seljuks in the 8th to 12th centuries and discusses how Chinese art found its way to the West, a process that also describes the migration of technology.
